recognize_zh: 側面頭顱 X 光片上，顱頂可見多發、大小相近的小圓形透亮區（punched-out lytic lesions），邊緣清楚且周圍沒有骨質硬化反應，是多發性骨髓瘤的典型影像表現。
features: Multiple small, round, well-circumscribed lucent lesions throughout the calvarium
Punched-out appearance without surrounding sclerotic rim
Lesions of similar size distributed diffusely (raindrop pattern)
describe_en: Lateral skull radiograph shows numerous small, round, sharply marginated lytic lesions scattered throughout the calvarium. The lesions have a punched-out appearance without a sclerotic rim or periosteal reaction. No expansile mass is evident at this resolution. The pattern is characteristic of multiple myeloma bone disease, with purely lytic lesions due to osteoclast activation and suppressed osteoblast function.

ddx.vs: Metastases are often more variable in size, may be sclerotic or mixed, and are typically hot on bone scan, whereas myeloma lesions are uniform, purely lytic and often cold on bone scan.
LCH usually produces fewer, larger lytic lesions with beveled edges ('hole within a hole') in a younger patient, rather than innumerable small uniform lesions.
Hyperparathyroidism gives fine granular mottling with subperiosteal resorption rather than discrete punched-out lesions, and PTH and calcium are elevated.
Venous lakes are few, irregular and connected to vascular channels, whereas these lesions are numerous, round and discrete.
